SharedFlowBundle.name: model-armor-sf
SharedFlowBundle.Description: Reusable flow that calls the Model Armor API on a request or response payload, raises a 403 on a content-safety match, and logs the verdict to Cloud Logging. Invoked from agent-tools-proxy via FlowCallout, once on the request path and once on the response path (direction passed in via the armor.direction FlowCallout parameter).
